extraction.text:
Mahesh Suryawanshi

Associate

I am a finance professional with one year of experience in trade operations,

specializing in U.S. market settlements. I possess proficiency in equity settlements,

trade reconciliation, and inventory management, all of which contribute to the

timely and accurate execution of trades. I possess expertise in managing

unmatched trades, effectively communicating with counterparties and the middle

office, and effectively addressing trade discrepancies. I have a wealth of

experience in processing cash equities, stock settlements, and corporate actions,

all while ensuring compliance with industry regulations. I possess a robust

comprehension of the trade life cycle, the intricacies of the market, and the

procedures involved in settlement. I excel in problem-solving, risk mitigation, and

collaborating with onshore stakeholders, including middle office and risk teams. I

am proficient in MS Excel, possessing strong analytical skills and a meticulous

approach.

Work History

2024-03 -

Associate - Trade Processing & Reconciliation

2025-04

Eviden, Pune, Maharashtra

Manage trade processing and settlements for equity and fixed-income products

across multiple U.S. markets. Custodians, ensuring trades are completed

accurately and on time.

Handle daily settlement activities, including trade matching, confirmation, and

coordination with custodians and counter parties, to avoid trade fails.

Carry out trade and position reconciliations, resolving breaks and discrepancies

quickly to maintain smooth operations.

Work closely with onshore teams, the middle office, compliance, and custodians

to resolve issues, and improve overall settlement efficiency.

Validated and maintained Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI), ensuring

settlement account details were accurate, complete, and aligned with client/

custodian instructions.

Monitor trade amendments, cash movements, and Standing Settlement

Instructions (SSIs) to ensure settlement details are up to date and accurate.

Coordinate with outsourced vendor teams on daily deliverables, follow up on

escalations, and track performance against service levels.

Managed and maintained client and entity reference data, validating mandatory

client attributes, account details, settlement information, and documentation to

ensure data accuracy and completeness across operational systems.

Support process improvement and automation efforts to reduce manual work,

and improve turnaround time.

Handle client and counterparty queries related to settlements, and ensure timely

and accurate responses.
